No data plate, serial number, or model markings are clearly readable in the photo.
No hoses, wiring harness, turbo, or exhaust manifold visibly attached; engine appears stripped or disconnected.

No oil stains or fluid pooling clearly visible, but photo angle and dirt make this hard to assess.
No video, sound, or exhaust smoke evidence of the engine running.
